title: 第十一章 你在质疑我第十二章 跃龙门
lines: 林昊蹙眉，李晴川要杀自己的心果然迫切，自己斩杀了徐岩松，恰好给了他们一个合理斩杀自己的理由。
现在看来，对方并不打算给自己跃龙门的机会。
“我要跃龙门。”
林昊大喊，运足了力气，声音滚滚荡荡，在整个太玄宗上空回荡。
“还愣着干什么，杀了他。”
李开先道。
“林昊，你带罪之身，没有资格跃龙门。”
李晴川手中多出一把利剑，一步步走向林昊：“现在，我奉长老旨意，将你处死。”
言罢，李晴川抬起了剑，斩向林昊，他脸上带着笑，很得意的那种。
刷！
李晴川的剑很快，出手夺命。
或者说，他杀林昊的心，迫切到极点。
在一道道目光注视下，李晴川的剑，自上而下，将林昊的身体，斩为两半。
但，李晴川的笑容马上凝固了，这一剑，并没有切破肉身的阻碍感。
残影！
“李师兄小心。”
有人惊呼。
李晴川感受到背后传来的破空风声，当即豁然转身，就见一只拳头迎面砸来。
李晴川毕竟是气海境七重强者，反应也快，真气催动之下，连忙后退丈许，躲掉林昊的拳头。
“混蛋。”
李晴川暴怒，其他人都震惊无比。
尤其是李开先，他身为化元境强者，眼光自非寻常人能比。
“那是什么身法？”
李开先眸子放光，适才一幕太惊艳了，林昊在如此近的距离，不但躲避掉李晴川的一剑，还能第一时间背后反击。
太快了，如芒似电。
李晴川怒火冲天，浑身真气滚荡，再次杀向林昊。
林昊内心叹息，差距太大了，不可能是对手。
但他不信，太玄宗的高层，就任由李晴川父子这样杀自己，他们父子真的就能在太玄宗只手遮天吗？
“住手。”
一声大喝响起，又有化元境强者出来。
那是一个老者，身穿道袍，五旬上下，须发皆白，却精神抖擞，面色红润，他出现的瞬间，凌空点出一道光，落在演武场，挡住了李晴川的攻势。
“任百川，你什么意思？”
看到来者，李开先脸色微变。
“我要给他跃龙门的机会。”
任百川道。
content_en:
Lin Hao frowned. Li Qingchuan was really eager to kill him. He killed Xu Yansong, which just gave them a reasonable reason to kill him.
Now it seems that the other party does not intend to give him a chance to jump over the dragon gate.
"I want to jump over the dragon gate."
Lin Hao shouted, exerting all his strength, his voice was loud and reverberated over the entire Taixuan Sect.
"What are you still doing? Kill him."
Li Kaixian said.
"Lin Hao, you are a guilty person and are not qualified to jump over the Dragon Gate."
Li Qingchuan had a sharp sword in his hand and walked towards Lin Hao step by step: "Now, according to the elder's order, I will execute you."
After saying that, Li Qingchuan raised his sword and slashed at Lin Hao, with a smile on his face, very proud of himself.
brush!
Li Qingchuan's sword was very fast and he struck out to kill someone.
In other words, his desire to kill Lin Hao was extremely urgent.
Under the gazes of one after another, Li Qingchuan's sword cut Lin Hao's body in half from top to bottom.
However, Li Qingchuan's smile immediately solidified. This sword did not cut through the physical body.
Afterimage!
"Senior Brother Li, be careful."
someone exclaimed.
Li Qingchuan felt the sound of wind breaking through the air from behind, and immediately turned around, only to see a fist coming towards him.
After all, Li Qingchuan was a strong man at the seventh level of the Qi Sea Realm, and his reaction was quick. Under the stimulation of his true energy, he quickly retreated a few feet to avoid Lin Hao's fist.
"Asshole."
Li Qingchuan was furious, and everyone else was shocked.
Especially Li Kaixian, as a strong man in Huayuan Realm, his vision is extraordinary.
"What kind of movement is that?"
Li Kaixian's eyes lit up. The scene just now was so amazing. At such a close distance, Lin Hao not only dodged Li Qingchuan's sword, but he could also fight back immediately.
It was so fast, like lightning.
Li Qingchuan was furious, his true energy billowing all over his body, and he killed Lin Hao again.
"Alas!"
Lin Hao sighed inwardly, the gap was too big and he could not be his opponent.
But he didn't believe that the senior officials of Taixuanzong allowed Li Qingchuan and his son to kill him like this. Can they really cover the sky with one hand in Taixuanzong?
"Stop."
A loud shout rang out, and another Huayuan realm powerhouse came out.
It was an old man, wearing a Taoist robe, in his fifties, with white beard and hair, but full of energy and a rosy complexion. The moment he appeared, a ray of light shot out from the sky and landed on the martial arts field, blocking Li Qingchuan's offensive.
"Ren Baichuan, what do you mean?"
Seeing the person coming, Li Kaixian's expression changed slightly.
"I want to give him a chance to leap over the Dragon Gate."
Ren Baichuan Road.
title_en: Chapter 11 You are questioning me Chapter 12 Leaping over the Dragon Gate
